readability.proof_scope: Complete ordered code, raw literal positions, other comments and Stonecutter directives; before identifiers normalized only at recorded exact local token occurrences.

repack_probe.scope: Actual core repack versus exact original shuffle method body, with fixed equivalent Random adapters and one notification stub. Not native random scheduling, NBT, packets, rendering, expiry placement or saved-world execution.

formal_findings_added.finding: Coin pile opacity changed from explicit water opacity 3 to native outline-derived 0.
formal_findings_added.evidence: Actual old world bridge delegates to the tile override; both native platform chains return 0 for the current fixed 16x2x16 outline, noOcclusion and empty fluid.
formal_findings_added.limit: Source/native bytecode inference, not an actual light-engine query or world brightness comparison.

formal_findings_added.finding: Ordinary coin pile pick returns the bare coin_pile BlockItem rather than a material/pattern-bearing coin.
formal_findings_added.evidence: Old actual world block forwards pick to the inherited tile writer. Current direct Block subclass has no clone override; actual Forge and Neo interface defaults and Block fallback create a new stack of the registered bare block item.
formal_findings_added.limit: Normal pick fallback only; no Ctrl-pick, external mods, client key press or saved world execution.

formal_findings_extended.scope: Original independent use3DCoins and use3DCoinsInv client options lack a port consumer. Current default 3D is implemented; CFG remains deliberately deferred, not reported as a default-path failure.

already_implemented_or_rejected: Current world save serializes all 16 cell counters and the real coin item; its custom data retains die/unique payload. Loading calls storeCoin and refreshes decoded pattern.

Coin chunk/update packet overrides exist. Real Forge packet/chunk defaults call load; Neo defaults call loadWithComponents and loadAdditional. This is source wiring, not live packet delivery/restart proof.
Forge and Neo actually register the world renderer and item extension. The model override distinguishes untagged/default and stamped items; neither entire platform is missing a coin renderer.
Current prefix coin amount is U9, as in original item recycling data. No missing amount finding.
Original internal registry item block does not extend the world block; actual placement swaps to the container MultiTileEntityBlock. Pick/opacity conclusions use that real world bridge.
All-zero flat world branch and Unique tooltip remain prior ALIGN-385/386; not duplicated here. Full material membership/cross-mod identity and native expiry lifecycle are not certified.

preparation_attempts.detail: Initial local rename matcher operated only on the comments/string scanner and matched no identifiers; now renames only exact identifier tokens in code gaps, with strict counts. Preview annotation occurrence guard was also corrected from one to two. No production mutation occurred until proof passed.

Unchanged issue-scope document has working-tree CRLF and Git LF; final comparison now uses normalized text instead of mismatched raw encodings. Source/resource/protected-material raw hashes still use exact bytes.
